```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

# Overview

**Run ID:** `r params$run_id`

**Report generated:** `r Sys.time()`

---

# Recording Effort

```{r effort-check}
has_effort <- !is.null(params$effort) && nrow(params$effort) > 0
if (!has_effort) cat("*No effort data available. Run Stage 1 first.*\n")
```

```{r effort-table, eval=has_effort}
eff_summary <- params$effort[, .(
  total_hours = round(sum(effort_hours), 1),
  n_days = .N,
  mean_daily_hours = round(mean(effort_hours), 1)
), by = site_id]
knitr::kable(eff_summary,
             col.names = c("Site", "Total Hours", "Days", "Mean Daily Hours"),
             caption = "Recording effort per site")
```

```{r effort-daily, eval=has_effort}
cat("\n**Daily effort (hours):**\n\n")
daily_wide <- data.table::dcast(
  params$effort,
  site_id ~ occasion_date,
  value.var = "effort_hours"
)
daily_wide[, (2:ncol(daily_wide)) := lapply(.SD, round, 1),
           .SDcols = 2:ncol(daily_wide)]
knitr::kable(daily_wide, caption = "Daily recording hours per site")
```

---

# Detection Summary

```{r det-check}
has_det <- !is.null(params$species_counts) &&
  nrow(params$species_counts) > 0
if (!has_det) cat("*No detection data available. Run Stage 4 first.*\n")
```

```{r det-table, eval=has_det}
knitr::kable(params$species_counts,
             col.names = c("Species", "Events", "Sites"),
             caption = "Detection summary by species (after cleaning)")
```

```{r det-barplot, eval=has_det, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
sc <- params$species_counts
sc <- sc[order(-events)]
short_names <- sub("_.*", "", sc$species)
barplot(sc$events,
        names.arg = short_names,
        las = 2, cex.names = 0.7,
        col = "steelblue",
        main = "Events per species",
        ylab = "Number of events")
```

```{r hourly-check}
has_hourly <- !is.null(params$hourly_pattern) &&
  nrow(params$hourly_pattern) > 0
```

```{r hourly-plot, eval=has_hourly, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
hp <- params$hourly_pattern
plot(hp$hour, hp$n,
     type = "h", lwd = 3, col = "darkorange",
     xlab = "Hour of day", ylab = "Detections",
     main = "Detection activity by hour",
     xaxt = "n")
axis(1, at = seq(0, 23, by = 2))
```

---

# Species Richness and Diversity

```{r rich-check}
has_rich <- !is.null(params$richness_sites) && nrow(params$richness_sites) > 0
if (!has_rich) {
  cat("*No richness data available. Run Stages 1 and 4 first.*\n")
}
```

```{r rich-intro, eval=has_rich, results="asis"}
cat("Richness is the number of species detected. The Hill numbers describe",
    "diversity as an effective number of species: order 1 weights species by",
    "how often they were detected (the exponential of Shannon diversity) and",
    "order 2 gives more weight to the commonest species (inverse Simpson).",
    "Only occasions with enough recording effort are used.\n\n")
```

```{r rich-table, eval=has_rich}
rich_display <- data.table::copy(params$richness_sites)
num_cols_rich <- names(rich_display)[vapply(rich_display, is.numeric, logical(1))]
rich_display[, (num_cols_rich) := lapply(.SD, round, 2), .SDcols = num_cols_rich]
knitr::kable(rich_display, caption = "Species richness and Hill numbers per site")
```

```{r rich-estimate, eval=has_rich}
est_display <- data.table::copy(params$richness_estimates)
num_cols_est <- names(est_display)[vapply(est_display, is.numeric, logical(1))]
est_display[, (num_cols_est) := lapply(.SD, round, 2), .SDcols = num_cols_est]
knitr::kable(est_display, caption = "Observed richness and the Chao2 estimate across sites")
```

```{r rich-accumulation, eval=has_rich, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
acc <- params$richness_accumulation
plot(acc$n_sites, acc$richness, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "steelblue",
     xlab = "Sites sampled", ylab = "Expected number of species",
     main = "Species accumulation over sites")
est <- params$richness_estimates
if (!is.null(est) && is.finite(est$chao2[1])) abline(h = est$chao2[1], lty = 2, col = "grey40")
```

---

# Activity Patterns

```{r act-check}
has_act <- !is.null(params$activity_hour) && nrow(params$activity_hour) > 0
has_season <- !is.null(params$activity_week) && nrow(params$activity_week) > 0
if (!has_act) {
  cat("*No activity data available. Run Stages 1 and 4 first.*\n")
}
top_species <- character()
if (has_act) {
  top_species <- if (!is.null(params$species_counts)) params$species_counts$species else
    unique(params$activity_hour$species)
  top_species <- head(intersect(top_species, params$activity_hour$species), 6)
}
```

```{r act-intro, eval=has_act, results="asis"}
cat("Activity is the number of detected events per hour of recording, so",
    "periods and sites recorded for different lengths of time can be compared.",
    "It describes how much a species calls, not how many animals there are.",
    "The six most detected species are shown.\n\n")
```

```{r act-hour, eval=has_act && length(top_species) > 0, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
act_h <- params$activity_hour
op <- par(mfrow = c(ceiling(length(top_species) / 2), 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
for (sp in top_species) {
  one <- act_h[act_h$species == sp, ]
  vals <- ifelse(is.na(one$detections_per_hour), 0, one$detections_per_hour)
  barplot(vals, names.arg = one$period, col = "steelblue", cex.main = 0.9,
          main = sub("_.*", "", sp), xlab = "Hour of day",
          ylab = "Detections per recorded hour")
}
par(op)
```

```{r act-week, eval=has_season && length(top_species) > 0, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
act_w <- params$activity_week
op <- par(mfrow = c(ceiling(length(top_species) / 2), 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
for (sp in top_species) {
  one <- act_w[act_w$species == sp, ]
  plot(one$period, one$detections_per_hour, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "darkorange",
       main = sub("_.*", "", sp), xlab = "Week starting", cex.main = 0.9,
       ylab = "Detections per recorded hour")
}
par(op)
```

# Validation Results

```{r val-check}
has_prec <- !is.null(params$precision) && nrow(params$precision) > 0
has_recall <- !is.null(params$recall) && nrow(params$recall) > 0
if (!has_prec && !has_recall) {
  cat("*No validation data available. Run Stages 5 and 5b first.*\n")
}
```

## Precision

```{r prec-table, eval=has_prec}
prec_display <- data.table::copy(params$precision)
num_cols <- names(prec_display)[sapply(prec_display, is.numeric)]
prec_display[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, round, 3), .SDcols = num_cols]
knitr::kable(prec_display,
             caption = "Precision by species and confidence band")
```

## Recall

```{r recall-table, eval=has_recall}
rec_display <- data.table::copy(params$recall)
num_cols_r <- names(rec_display)[sapply(rec_display, is.numeric)]
rec_display[, (num_cols_r) := lapply(.SD, round, 3),
            .SDcols = num_cols_r]
knitr::kable(rec_display,
             caption = "Recall by species and threshold")
```

## Species thresholds

```{r thr-check}
has_thr <- !is.null(params$thresholds) && nrow(params$thresholds) > 0
```

```{r thr-table, eval=has_thr}
thr_display <- data.table::copy(params$thresholds)
num_cols_thr <- names(thr_display)[vapply(thr_display, is.numeric, logical(1))]
thr_display[, (num_cols_thr) := lapply(.SD, round, 3), .SDcols = num_cols_thr]
knitr::kable(thr_display, caption = "Confidence threshold chosen for each species")
```

# Occupancy Summary

```{r occ-check}
has_occ <- !is.null(params$occupancy) && nrow(params$occupancy) > 0
if (!has_occ) {
  cat("*No occupancy data available. Run Stage 6 first.*\n")
}
```

```{r occ-table, eval=has_occ}
occ_display <- data.table::copy(params$occupancy)
occ_display$naive_occupancy <- round(occ_display$naive_occupancy, 3)
occ_display$threshold_used <- round(occ_display$threshold_used, 2)
knitr::kable(occ_display,
             col.names = c("Species", "Threshold", "Sites",
                           "Occasions", "Sites Detected",
                           "Naive Occupancy"),
             caption = "Naive occupancy estimates per species")
```
